The 4th coordinate is chosen per pose ON the scored bench, from the bench's own exact skin distance: psi = the k with the largest min metal among the 17 k that take the pose. That is a best-of-17 per pose on the scored measure. A controller learned off the scored poses does much less. This audit took the claim-bench psi of the nearest bench ws pose (median distance 15 deg, the grid step) and read whether it takes each held pose from the held k-table's take sets. The held gate rises from 10.93 to >= 17.3-19.1 (contacts at the lost poses not measured, so this is a lower bound). For comparison, phi40 held reads 16.69 gate. The takes are also fragile: 12 of 36 bench new takes have a taking-k run narrower than 10 deg and 2 take at one k only (127 at 2.5, 354 at 40). Watch: this nearest-neighbour map is crude, a dense body-model table would do better, and the powered product could carry one. But the claim is the oracle's upper bound, not a controller's number.
